FalstadHammerangGatheringStorm.name: Gathering Storm
FalstadHammerangGatheringStorm.description: Quest: Every time Hammerang hits a Hero increase its damage by 0.5% and refund 6 Mana. Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes with Hammerang, increase its damage by 15%.

FalstadLightningRodDishonorableDischarge.name: Dishonorable Discharge
FalstadLightningRodDishonorableDischarge.description: Reduce Lightning Rod's cooldown by 2 seconds. Quest: After 3 Lightning Rod strikes, subsequent strikes on enemy Heroes increases its damage by 1%, up to 75%. Reward: After 30 subsequent strikes, further reduce Lightning Rod's cooldown by 2 seconds. Reward: After 75 subsequent str

FalstadTailwindFrequentFlyer.name: Frequent Flyer
FalstadTailwindFrequentFlyer.description: Activate Frequent Flyer to gain 40% Attack Speed and Tailwind for 4 seconds. Quest: Minion kills grant 0.2 Basic Attack Damage. Hero Takedowns grant 0.5 Basic Attack Damage.

FalstadMasteryLightningRodStaticShield.name: Static Shield
FalstadMasteryLightningRodStaticShield.description: Lightning Rod strikes grant a Shield equal to 4% of Falstad's maximum Health, up to 28%, for 4 seconds.

FalstadMasteryUpdraftBarrelRoll.name: Updraft
FalstadMasteryUpdraftBarrelRoll.description: Increases Barrel Roll's range by 40% and Shield amount by 70%, and its Shield now lasts indefinitely.

FalstadTalentHammerGains.name: Hammer Gains
FalstadTalentHammerGains.description: Basic Attacks heal for 20% of the damage dealt to the primary target.

FalstadMasteryHammerangSecretWeapon.name: Secret Weapon
FalstadMasteryHammerangSecretWeapon.description: Increases Hammerang's range by 30% and Basic Attacks deal 75% bonus damage while Hammerang is in flight.

FalstadHammerangBOOMerang.name: BOOMerang
FalstadHammerangBOOMerang.description: Hammerang's explosion deals 100% additional damage, and hitting enemy Heroes reduces their Spell Armor by 15 for 3 seconds.

FalstadMasteryLightningRodChargedUp.name: Charged Up
FalstadMasteryLightningRodChargedUp.description: Increases the number of Lightning Rod strikes by 2 and its range by 25%.

FalstadHeroicAbilityHinterlandBlast.name: Hinterland Blast
FalstadHeroicAbilityHinterlandBlast.description: After 1 second, deal 475 (+4.75% per level) damage to enemies within a long line. The cooldown is reduced by 30 seconds for every enemy Hero hit.

FalstadHeroicAbilityMightyGust.name: Mighty Gust
FalstadHeroicAbilityMightyGust.description: Push enemies away, and slow their Movement Speed by 40% decaying over 4 seconds.

FalstadMasteryLightningRodThunderstrikes.name: Thunderstrikes
FalstadMasteryLightningRodThunderstrikes.description: Lightning Rod deals 25% more damage each subsequent strike.

FalstadMasteryBarrelRollFlowRider.name: Flow Rider
FalstadMasteryBarrelRollFlowRider.description: While Tailwind is active, Falstad's Basic Abilities recharge 100% faster.

FalstadTailwindSustainedWinds.name: Sustained Winds
FalstadTailwindSustainedWinds.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 1.5% of the Hero's maximum Health, increased to 2% while Tailwind is active.

FalstadMasteryCripplingHammerHammerang.name: Crippling Hammer
FalstadMasteryCripplingHammerHammerang.description: Increase Hammerang's Slow from 25% to 50%, and Hammerang's explosion also Slows.

FalstadMasteryAerieGustsTailwind.name: Aerie Gusts
FalstadMasteryAerieGustsTailwind.description: Reduces the activation time for Tailwind from 5 to 3 seconds, and increases the Movement Speed bonus from 15% to 25%.

FalstadMasteryAfterburner.name: Afterburner
FalstadMasteryAfterburner.description: Barrel Roll increases Movement Speed by 60%, decaying over 3 seconds.

FalstadMasteryCalloftheWildhammerHinterl.name: Call of the Wildhammer
FalstadMasteryCalloftheWildhammerHinterl.description: Hinterland Blast has double the range and deals 25% more damage.

FalstadMasteryMightyGustWindTunnel.name: Wind Tunnel
FalstadMasteryMightyGustWindTunnel.description: Mighty Gust creates a wind tunnel for 4 seconds. Enemies caught in the tunnel will periodically be pushed back.

GenericTalentNexusFrenzy.name: Nexus Frenzy
GenericTalentNexusFrenzy.description: Increases Attack Speed by 20% and Attack Range by 1.1.

FalstadMasteryFlightEpicMount.name: Epic Mount
FalstadMasteryFlightEpicMount.description: Reduce the cooldown of Flight by 50 seconds, reduce the cast time before flying to 0.5 seconds, and increase the speed by 50%.
